author: D. Babusci et al.
title: Measurement of the $K_{S}\to \pi e \nu$ branching fraction with the KLOE experiment
abstract: The ratio $\mathcal{R} = \Gamma(K_{S}\to \pi e \nu)/\Gamma(K_{S}\to \pi^+ \pi^-)$ has been measured with a sample of 300 million $K_{S}$ mesons produced in $\phi \to K_{L} K_{S}$ decays recorded by the KLOE experiment at the DA$\Phi$NE $e^+ e^-$ collider. With $49647 \pm 316$ signal events we measure $\mathcal{R} = (1.0421 \pm 0.0066_{\rm stat} \pm 0.0075_{\rm syst}) \times 10^{-3}$. The combination with our previous measurement gives $\mathcal{R} = (1.0338 \pm 0.0054_{\rm stat} \pm 0.0064_{\rm syst}) \times 10^{-3}$. From this value we derive the branching fraction $\mathcal{B}(K_{S} \to \pi e \nu) = (7.153 \pm 0.037_{\rm stat} \pm 0.044_{\rm syst}) \times 10^{-4}$ and $f_+(0)|V_{us}| = 0.2170 \pm 0.0009$.
